run_speed_test: run a speed benchmark comparing LeViT, ResNet, DeiT, and EfficientNet models on CPU and CUDA devices
compute_throughput_cpu: compute the CPU inference throughput of a TorchScript-traced model in images per second
compute_throughput_cuda: compute the CUDA inference throughput of a TorchScript-traced model using AMP autocast in images per second
benchmark_levit_models: benchmark LeViT-128S, LeViT-128, LeViT-192, LeViT-256, and LeViT-384 models against timm baselines
trace_and_benchmark_model: trace a PyTorch model with torch.jit.trace and measure its throughput on a given device
